2609.26175.title: EADC: Evaluation of Advanced and Deep-level Compliance in Large Language Models
2609.26175.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used in various industries. However, ensuring their compliance with complex laws and regulatory frameworks remains a great challenge. Existing evaluation paradigms mainly rely on static benchmarks that suffer from three severe limitations: First, the compliance rules being used do not comply with the requirements of Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and regulations; Second, they only handle apparent, explicit compliance risks, leaving implicit and covert compliance risks undetected; Third, they fail to track the systematic propagation of risks along logical dependency chains or evaluate compliance within nuanced, context-based real-world scenarios. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce EADC, a novel advanced evaluation benchmark of LLMs based on an AI compliance knowledge graph and AI compliance legal experts. By mapping abstract legal rules into structured logical multi-relational graphs, our framework enables automated, evolving agents to distill and synthesize highly sophisticated adversarial scenarios. This compliance benchmark is reviewed and corrected by human AI legal experts throughout the whole process. The resulting dataset (4,435+ QA pairs) provides an extensive, multi-dimensional taxonomy covering critical regulatory frontiers, including bias and discrimination, fairness, personal privacy protection, and values. Crucially, our compliance dataset moves beyond shallow string-matching by incorporating contextual long-horizon interactions and logic-driven hazard chains, capturing deeply embedded compliance anomalies that bypass traditional filters. Experiment evaluations demonstrate that our framework exposes critical regulatory blind spots in state-of-the-art LLMs, offering a rigorous, AI laws and regulations-aligned benchmark to safeguard high-level and deep compliance in the application of LLMs.
2609.26175.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）已被應用於各個行業。<lb/>然而，確保它們遵守複雜的法律和監管框架仍然是一個重大挑戰。<lb/>現有的評估範式主要依賴靜態基準，這些基準存在三個嚴重的限制：第一，所使用的合規規則不符合人工智慧（AI）法律和法規的要求；<lb/>第二，它們僅處理明顯的、顯性的合規風險，留下隱性的和隱秘的合規風險未被檢測；<lb/>第三，它們未能追蹤風險在邏輯依賴鏈中的系統性傳播，或在細微的、基於情境的現實場景中評估合規性。<lb/>為了填補這一關鍵空白，我們介紹了EADC，一個基於AI合規知識圖譜和AI合規法律專家的新型先進LLMs評估基準。<lb/>通過將抽象的法律規則映射到結構化的邏輯多關係圖中，我們的框架使自動化的、演變的代理能夠提煉和綜合高度複雜的對抗場景。<lb/>這一合規基準在整個過程中由人類AI法律專家進行審查和修正。<lb/>最終生成的數據集（4,435+ QA對）提供了一個廣泛的、多維的分類法，涵蓋關鍵的監管前沿，包括偏見和歧視、公平、個人隱私保護和價值觀。<lb/>至關重要的是，我們的合規數據集超越了淺層的字符串匹配，通過納入情境長期互動和邏輯驅動的危害鏈，捕捉深層嵌入的合規異常，這些異常繞過了傳統的過濾器。<lb/>實驗評估顯示，我們的框架揭示了最先進的LLMs中的關鍵監管盲點，提供了一個嚴謹的、與AI法律和法規對齊的基準，以保障LLMs應用中的高層次和深層合規。
